text: Every morning at 09:00 from tomorrow, DM me a 'Coastal team digest' of anything new in #coastal-team.
reply_text:
I can't set up a recurring 09:00 DM from here. My world tools don't include scheduling, and the only scheduler available in this session is local-only: its output isn't delivered to your DMs. So I won't create a job that looks like it's running but never reaches you.

What I can do is send you a "Coastal team digest" on request, covering new posts in #coastal-team since the last one you got. Ask me whenever you want one, and I'll check that you're still a member of the channel before reading it. For a true daily delivery, someone with scheduling access on the workspace would need to set up a recurring job that posts to your DM.
